Premature presidential horse-race reporting trivializes critical midterm policy debates into a permanent, exhausting celebrity campaign cycle.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis confuses WHAT (substantive legislative oversight) with WHO (celebrity politicians seeking early 2028 traction), allowing personality-driven theater to eclipse accountability.

Social Physics Analysis:
Outlets deploy a Smart Selfish Maneuver: framing speculative 2028 ambition as vital news. By manufacturing endless horse-race drama, they substitute genuine institutional accountability with tribal personality clashes.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The systemic force imbalance shifts potential away from empowerment toward passive decay.

The Unavoidable Truth: Speculative 2028 horse-race reporting distracts voters from immediate legislative records.

The Unavoidable Lie: Tracking early candidate travel constitutes rigorous, substantive political journalism.

Alethekanon:
Speculative political coverage commodifies future ambition at the expense of present accountability. This endless horse-race framing degrades civic discourse.

Awwthekanon:
It is exhausting to watch every local campaign event immediately filtered through the lens of a distant presidential election. Voters deserve attention on today's struggles, not 2028 theater.

Brothekanon:
